storyP1.en: Founded over a decade ago, MH India Trips was born from a simple vision: to showcase the rich heritage, vibrant colors, and spiritual depth of India without compromising on comfort. We believe that travel should be slow, immersive, and custom-tailored to the individual traveler.
storyP1.es: Fundada hace más de una década, MH India Trips nació de una visión simple: mostrar el rico patrimonio, los colores vibrantes y la profundidad espiritual de la India sin comprometer el confort.
storyP1.pt: Fundada há mais de uma década, a MH India Trips nasceu de uma visão simples: mostrar o rico patrimônio, as cores vibrantes e a profundidade espiritual da Índia sem comprometer o conforto.

storyP2.en: From private dinners inside medieval desert forts to custom houseboat tours on Kerala's tranquil backwaters, our on-ground concierge team works tirelessly to ensure every detail is absolute perfection. We don't just book tours; we curate life-defining memories.
storyP2.es: Desde cenas privadas en fuertes medievales del desierto hasta paseos a medida en casas flotantes por los canales de Kerala, nuestro equipo trabaja incansablemente para que cada detalle sea perfecto.
storyP2.pt: De jantares privados em fortes medievais do deserto a passeios sob medida em barcos nos canais de Kerala, nossa equipe trabalha incansavelmente para que cada detalhe seja perfeito.

guide1Title.es: Mujer viajando sola por la India

guide1Desc.en: India is highly welcoming to foreign guests. For female travelers, we guarantee private transfers with verified professional chauffeurs, government-certified local guides at all monument check-points, and 24/7 active concierge helpline support.
guide1Desc.es: La India es muy acogedora con los viajeros. Para las mujeres que viajan solas, garantizamos traslados privados con choferes profesionales verificados, guías locales certificados y asistencia telefónica activa las 24 horas.
guide1Desc.pt: A Índia é acolhedora para os visitantes. Para mulheres viajando sozinhas, garantizamos traslados privados com motoristas profissionais verificados, guias locais credenciados e assistência de concierge ativa 24/7.

guide2Desc.en: October to March is the ideal season for most of India, featuring warm days and cool evenings. The Himalayan ranges are perfect in summer, and South India remains lush and beautiful year-round.
guide2Desc.es: De octubre a marzo es la temporada ideal para la mayor parte de la India, con días templados y noches frescas. Las regiones del Himalaya son perfectas en verano y el sur permanece verde todo el año.
guide2Desc.pt: De outubro a março é a temporada ideal para a maioria das regiões, com dias amenos e noites frescas. O Himalaia é perfeito no verão e o sul permanece verde e exuberante o ano todo.

guide3Desc.en: Basic precautions ensure an amazing holiday. Up-to-date routine vaccines are recommended. Drink only sealed bottled water, eat at vetted hygiene-inspected dining rooms, and pack standard traveler first-aid guides.
guide3Desc.es: Precauciones básicas aseguran unas vacaciones perfectas. Se recomiendan vacunas de rutina actualizadas. Beba solo agua embotellada, coma en restaurantes seleccionados e higiénicos, y lleve un botiquín básico.
guide3Desc.pt: Precauções básicas garantem férias perfeitas. Recomendamos vacinas de rotina atualizadas. Beba apenas água mineral engarrafada, coma em locais higiênicos selecionados e leve itens básicos de saúde.

guide4Desc.en: The local currency is the Indian Rupee (INR). International credit cards are widely used in luxury hotels, boutiques, and high-end dining. Carrying some cash is helpful for tips and local heritage craft markets.
guide4Desc.es: La moneda local es la Rupia India (INR). Las tarjetas de crédito internacionales son ampliamente aceptadas en hoteles de lujo, boutiques y restaurantes. Llevar algo de efectivo es útil para propinas y mercados.
guide4Desc.pt: A moeda local é a Rúpia Indiana (INR). Cartões de crédito internacionais são amplamente aceitos em hotéis de luxo, boutiques e restaurantes. Ter dinheiro em mãos é útil para gorjetas e mercados locais.

guide5Desc.en: Wear light, breathable cotton layers. It is respectful to dress modestly when visiting temples and spiritual shrines (shoulders and knees covered). Slip-on shoes are ideal as shoes are removed at holy sites.
guide5Desc.es: Lleve ropa ligera de algodón. Es respetuoso vestir con modestia al visitar templos y lugares espirituales (hombros y rodillas cubiertos). Los zapatos fáciles de quitar son ideales, ya que se retiran en templos.
guide5Desc.pt: Use roupas leves de algodão. Vista-se de maneira respeitosa ao visitar templos e locais sagrados (ombros e joelhos cobertos). Sapatos fáceis de tirar são ideais, pois são retirados nos tempos.

1. Information We Collect

We collect personal information you provide when making inquiries, booking tours, or subscribing to our newsletter. This includes your name, email, phone number, travel preferences, and passport information when required for bookings.

2. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used to: plan and customize your travel itinerary, communicate about your booking, send relevant travel updates and offers (with your consent), and improve our services.

3. Data Protection

We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal data. Your information is stored securely and is only accessible to authorized team members who need it to provide our services.

4. Third-Party Sharing

We share your information only with trusted partners directly involved in delivering your travel experience (hotels, transport providers, guides). We never sell your personal data to third parties.

5. Cookies

Our website uses cookies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze website traffic. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. Contact us at hello@mhindiatrips.com for any data-related requests.

7. Contact

For questions about this privacy policy, contact us at hello@mhindiatrips.com or +91 98765 43210.

Last updated: August 2026

1. Booking & Payments

A 30% deposit is required to confirm your booking. The remaining balance is due 30 days before the trip start date. All payments are processed securely through our authorized payment partners.

2. Cancellation Policy

Cancellations made 60+ days before departure: full refund minus processing fees. 30-59 days: 50% refund. Less than 30 days: no refund. We recommend travel insurance for all bookings.

3. Itinerary Changes

We reserve the right to modify itineraries due to unforeseen circumstances (weather, political situations, natural disasters). Alternative arrangements of equal or higher quality will be provided.

4. Travel Insurance

We strongly recommend comprehensive travel insurance covering trip cancellation, medical emergencies, and personal belongings. This is the traveler's responsibility.

5. Liability

MH India Trips acts as an intermediary between travelers and service providers. While we carefully vet all partners, we are not liable for acts of third-party service providers, natural disasters, or force majeure events.

6. Health & Vaccinations

Travelers are responsible for ensuring they have appropriate vaccinations and health clearances. We provide guidance but recommend consulting your doctor before travel.

7. Code of Conduct

Travelers are expected to respect local customs, cultural sites, and communities. We reserve the right to terminate services without refund in cases of inappropriate behavior.

Se requiere un depósito del 30% para confirmar su reserva. El saldo restante debe pagarse 30 días antes de la fecha de inicio del viaje. Todos los pagos se procesan de forma segura a través de nuestros socios autorizados.

Cancelaciones realizadas con más de 60 días de antelación al inicio: reembolso completo menos gastos de gestión. De 30 a 59 días: reembolso del 50%. Menos de 30 días: sin reembolso. Recomendamos un seguro de viaje.

Nos reservamos el derecho de modificar itinerarios debido a circunstancias imprevistas (clima, situaciones políticas, desastres naturales). Se proporcionarán alternativas de igual o mayor calidad.

Recomendamos encarecidamente un seguro de viaje completo que cubra cancelación del viaje, emergencias médicas y equipaje personal. Esto es responsabilidad del viajero.

MH India Trips actúa como intermediario entre los viajeros y los proveedores de servicios. No somos responsables por los actos de los proveedores, desastres naturales o eventos de fuerza mayor.

Los viajeros son responsables de asegurarse de tener las vacunas y autorizaciones de salud adecuadas. Brindamos orientación pero recomendamos consultar a su médico antes de viajar.
